evidence: After the PATH-restricted command "PATH=\"/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin\" ffprobe ..." returned "Exit code 127 (eval):1: command not found: ffprobe", the run switched to "PATH=\"/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin\" /opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe ..." and then "/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg -i .../reel.mp4 -ss 1 -vframes 1 ... reel-cover.jpg", reaching the encoder/prober by absolute path outside the job's stated PATH-restricted environment to produce the cover image.
